svg.title: The locked design: one state, many questions, every option in its own lane
svg.desc: Diagram: a causal backbone prefills the state once; each question forks from the exact cached state; every option is scored in its own lane, which reads the state but never another option; heads give choice probabilities, yes/no, score and a null outcome; per-type calibration fitted on held-out sources; the bar is the calibrated zero-shot readout of the same backbone; a cached-option path for agent loops follows in milestone 2 behind a go/no-go.
